name: Zegna
why: The Biella mill itself — fiber to suit, Oasi-traceable.
origin: Ermenegildo Zegna, Trivero, 1910 — a wool mill whose founder planted half a million trees around it.
opview: Positions itself as fiber to suit — the mill as the maison.

notes.wool: it is the Biella mill — fiber to finished suit
notes.finbro: the MD suit — what the promotion is tailored in
notes.ital: The Trivero mill, and the Oasi Zegna above it — the family planted half a million trees on the mountain across the twentieth century. Few houses have altered their own landscape.
notes.racquet: Club dress rather than sportswear — the jacket you wear to the match, not the shirt you play it in.
notes.boat: Crewed-deck resort dress, cut in cloth the house wove itself. Comfortable rather than nautical.

cities: The full circuit — Boyds, Mitchells, Mario's, Halls & more · own boutiques in six metros
